verdict.rationale: Runloop's marketing site documents '10GB image startup time in <2s' and a 1-minute quickstart, supporting sub-second-to-few-second cold starts, but this is a single first-party marketing claim without detailed benchmarks, methodology, or independent corroboration. missing for 10: independent/third-party benchmark confirmation, documentation of cold start times across varying image sizes/configurations, and reproducible performance data beyond the single homepage claim.
